name: Sawada Kio
source: A former student, who acts as Ryougoku's helper. He grew up in an orphanage, until one day a certain pharmacist took him in to experiment on-- until Ryougoku saved him from that cruel treatment. Ever since then, he's been head-over-heels in love with Ryougoku.
